title: eludite.git.rebase input
description: Rebase the current branch onto another (the Git Repository window's Rebase current branch onto): its commits are replayed one by one on `onto`. On a conflict it stops with the conflicted paths (their files have markers); stage each resolved file and call again with `action: continue`, or `abort` to return to where it started. Rewrites history: history class for agents. Interactive rebase is not offered. The repository is the one discovered from the open workspace (solution folder or opened folder) upward, as `git` discovers it; without one the command fails naming eludite.git.init.
x-eludite-escalates: Dangerous for an agent when the solution's policy sets `git.history` to `prompt` (the default), refused when `deny`.

onto.description: The branch or revision to rebase onto (for `start`).
